name: 3Guys Broadband Internet
summary: Dialup + ADSL + hosting ISP with a community/sport-club focus ('Community Net'); only live capture 2006, defunct as an ISP by ~2007–2008 (domain later became an unrelated recipe site) (J.S CARTER & R.W HOLT & M.H SHEPPARD (partnership), ABN 48 863 846 184).

names.name: 3Guys Broadband Internet
source: Birth inferred; earliest Wayback capture is 3 Feb 2006 (no launch date on page): https://web.archive.org/web/20060203134640/http://3guys.com.au/

events.details: Dialup, ADSL, hosting; community/sport-club focus ('Community Net'). Birth year inferred (low confidence) — earliest Wayback capture is 3 Feb 2006 with no launch date shown.

Only functioning ISP capture is Feb 2006; site broken (HTTP 500) by Feb 2007; homepage was a 302 redirect to a default IIS/ASP page 2008–2012; domain repurposed as 'In2Recipes' WordPress site by 2013. Prior evidence misread the site as a 2007 redirect stub; in fact the retail store ran until late 2009 and was erroring by early 2011. retail store live 25 Oct 2009; site erroring by Feb 2011.

refs.label: CandyPress retail store still selling ADSL plans on 25 Oct 2009 — both the current (2007-08) and proposed (2007) deaths are too early
